Name: Item Mastery
Author: Bloofy58
Description:
Item Mastery adds a progression system to every single item in the game. Pick up a Parsnip, swing your Pickaxe, eat a meal, give a gift — everything you do with items earns XP and unlocks permanent bonuses the more you use them.
This is version 1.4 and I'm actively looking to improve it. Whether you find 
a bug, think a bonus doesn't fit an item, or have an idea for a new mechanic — 
feel free to reach out via the Posts tab or send me a DM. Every suggestion is welcome.


How it works?

Every item has its own XP bar and mastery level, from 1 to 20 by default. 
As you level up an item, bonuses unlock progressively based on what family 
that item belongs to. A Pickaxe reduces energy costs. A weapon deals more damage. 
A crop sells for more and eventually yields bonus harvests. Each family has its 
own progression curve with a unique level 20 capstone bonus. 
Warning: bonuses only apply to the item in question.


How to gain XP

Enabled:
Picking up items : Each item instance gives XP onc.
Using tools : XP every second while actively using a tool.
Eating food : XP when finishing a meal.
Gifting to villagers : XP when giving a gift to an NPC.
Use a machine: XP for collecting the item
Disabled but can be enabled using GMCM:
Selling items : purchased items give 80% less XP.
Crafting / Cooking


Menus & UI

The mod adds a dedicated mastery menu (F5 by default) where you can browse 
every item you have encountered, check its current level and XP progress, 
and see exactly which bonuses are active. Clicking any item opens a detailed 
profile showing its full progression bar across all 20 levels, its item family, 
description, and a breakdown of every active bonus.


Configuration (GMCM)

Everything is configurable by Generic Mod Config Menu:
- Global XP Multiplier — scales all XP gains (0.1×–10×)
- Max Level — default 20, up to 100
- Level Scaling Multiplier — XP cost between levels (default 1.3×)
- Enable/disable each XP source and bonus category individually
- Search bar, sort button, family filter — all optional UI elements in the mastery menu
- Reset XP for an item

Compatibility

- Multiplayer: local player only, no sync between players
- Should be compatible with most content mods
- Should normally take into account objects added by other mods.
- Automate: No major issues here, but just remember to collect the loot from your machines yourself, don’t use the chest if you want them to gain XP.


Translation

- English and French made by me
- Please feel free to translate this mod into your own language.

Requirements

- SMAPI 4.0+
- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional but highly recommended)


This is version 1.4 help make it better.

The bonus system is intentionally designed to be flexible, but I'm sure some 
bonuses don't feel right for certain items, and some item families could use 
more creative or fitting effects.
If you have ideas, I want to hear them:
- A bonus that would fit a specific item better?
- A mechanic you'd like to see added?
- Something that feels unbalanced or off?
- A bug you encountered?
Post on the mod page or send me a DM — I read everything.
And please feel free to suggest images and leave an endorsement, it helps raise the mod’s profile
